body:
`submit` saves Rust items by name and refuses code with errors, using the check from task:da797576d0cfaaac (D-158 point 3). Plan: this task's investigation, note 4; the human's answer: agents work with Rust as with Gleam, with the same commands, forms and replies. Reading by name and the session are task:ac5ae78fb2e94ab2; new containers, new modules and `delete` are task:5ce78f3fa5e3d808; whole-module `submit <module>` is task:4f544f48f7b2f1c0; refs, impact and test reach are task:d7aa4d5e523a065c.

**First:** add **D-168** to `DECISIONS.md`. It amends D-167 point 2 and D-158 point 6. It records the human's answer (one API for Rust and Gleam), the parent-opening wrapper (Parsing), and the split of work across these five tasks.

- **Routing (`main.rs::run_inner`):** remove the "Rust projects can't take `submit` yet" reply; in a Rust store allow `submit` and `drafts` (still E6013 `cargo::MISSING` without cargo). `refs` and `impact` name task:d7aa4d5e523a065c; `extract`, `merge`, `probe` keep their refusal (D-158 point 6). `drafts.rs::submit` keeps its routes. Drafts (D-46) and history/undo are language-neutral: a rejected submit keeps its draft.
- **Parsing (new Rust functions in `store.rs`, called from `Store::submit_symbols` / `Store::submit` when `language::is_rust`):**
  - Top-level item: `cargo::format_item`, then `language::rust::split(text, module)`.
  - Nested item (stored symbol has a `parent`): wrap it in the parent's own opening text plus `}`, format, split, take the one child. Works alike for `impl`, `trait`, inline `mod` and `extern` parents. The child's name is the parent's name, `::`, its own name; a rename is allowed, as in Gleam.
  - `cargo.rs::format_item`: `nested: bool` becomes `opening: Option<&str>` and returns the formatted wrapper; remove `unwrap`, `indent` and `#[allow(dead_code)]`; update `cargo_tests.rs`.
  - Each `split` refusal (D-158 point 2) replies "Not saved", draft kept.
- **Storing:**
  - Edit: update `text`, `revision`, `name`, `kind`; keep `parent`, `sep`, `tail`, `ord`.
  - Add: a Rust insert setting `parent` and `sep`; `ord` is the module's (or parent's) highest plus 1. The new item takes the old last item's `sep`, and the old last item gets `"\n\n"`, so the file keeps its blank lines and its ending.
  - `--new board::agents` adds top-level items; `--new board::agents.Store` adds a method, resolving among `impl`, `trait` and `mod` containers only, to the first `impl Store` when there are several.
  - Name lookup for `submit` leaves containers out, so `board::agents.Store` isn't ambiguous between `struct Store` and `impl Store`.
  - Refused until their task lands, each reply naming it: a submitted `impl`/`trait` container, adding to an empty `impl`, and new modules (task:5ce78f3fa5e3d808); a whole-module `submit board::agents` (task:4f544f48f7b2f1c0).
- **Imports:** in a Rust store skip `missing_imports`, `merge_import`, `import_statements`, `weak_asserts`, the `unimported_name` loop and `same_name_hint`. `submit --imports <module>` replaces the header only when its split has no items and no refusals, and its `mod x;` list is unchanged.
- **Checking:** after storing, `check_all`; errors on the submitted symbols reply "Not saved: the submitted text has errors." with cargo's message, then `cargo::ROUND_NOTE`.
- **Block headers:** `submit_symbols` and `drafts.rs::base` read the name with `split([' ', '('])`, which breaks `<Failure as fmt::Display>::fmt`. Read up to ` ──` and drop a trailing ` (kind)`.
- **Docs:** `reference.txt` and the READMEs: submit text that says Gleam only.

### Tests (`store_tests.rs` or a new `store_submit_tests.rs`; need `cargo` and `rustfmt`)
- Editing a function and a method leaves every other byte of the file unchanged.
- `--new` adds a top-level item and a method with the right spacing.
- A `split` refusal keeps the draft; a container, a whole module and a new module are refused, naming their task.
- A type error replies "Not saved" with the round note and keeps the draft.
- `--imports` accepts a header of `use` lines and refuses one with an item or a changed `mod x;` list.
- A block named `<T as Tr>::f` submits.
- Undoing a Rust submit restores the file byte for byte.

Out of scope: cargo's suggested fixes. Not checked: `callee_hint` and `broken_report` in Rust replies; whether `rustfmt` can be missing where `cargo` is.
title: Rust: submit saves items
